prior_decision_handling: NONE_SELECTED rejects previously shown pictures, not all future sources. Existing user-selected exact originals remain locked; new sources are not automatic replacements.
picture_policy: Exact-site photo of exterior, interior, altar, grotto, relic or venerated image is acceptable if clearly and truthfully labelled, legally reusable and linked to the canonical Place. No generic devotional image may masquerade as a site photograph.
source_priority: Openverse non-Wikimedia openly licensed results (especially Flickr)
authoritative institutional image source with reusable rights
other library results with verifiable commercial and derivative rights
prohibited: No money or contacting rights holders
No all-rights-reserved image copied into public app without permission
No reinterpretation of historical source rejections
No auto publication of image-search hits
No external API retries/mirrors after HTTP 429
